children: On September 17, an address identified as 0xeBf…f22B6 withdrew 4,827 ETH from a centralized exchange (CEX) at 1:35 a.m., according to Ai Yi monitoring. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the withdrawal price was $2,416.14 per ETH.
ETH later fell to a low of $2,358.88, leaving the address with an unrealized loss of about $276,000 at one point. As ETH rebounded, the position has since returned to profit.

title: Address Withdraws 4,827 ETH From CEX as Position Returns to Profit After Price Rebound
